info.title: Don't Touch Kotesashi
info.synopsis: Koyo Kotesashi possiede eccezionali abilità come massaggiatore, desidera diventare un medico sportivo e vuole ottenere una borsa di studio in medicina. A partire dalla primavera, frequenterà il liceo collegato alla Seiwa University. Date le difficoltà economiche in cui versa è costretto a gestire un ostello per pagare le spese scolastiche facendo intanto pratica con alcune atlete delle scuole superiori con vari problemi fisici.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Koyo is on a mission to take care of five high school girls with his massages and magic hands.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Koyo is accused of stealing Aroma's panties. Will his first day as the dorm caretaker be his last?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The bedroom battle heats up between Koyo's magic touch and Aoba's seductive tricks. Who will win in the end?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Izumi can't win a swim meet due to severe anxiety. Will Koyo's masterful massage be enough to help her unwind?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Izumi wants to win, no matter what—even if it means letting Koyo massage her in a very private area!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Koyo must poke and prod Chiyo's most sensitive area—all so she can win against an online gamer?

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo is willing to endure Koyo's near-torture treatment, but will it be too much for her?

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Miyuki's brutal training camp pushes her volleyball team to the brink, and only Koyo can save the day!

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: When Koyo teaches Miyuki how to massage him, he discovers she's good enough to be his rival!

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Koyo is assigned to look after Aroma after her injury, but is she capable of staying in bed and healing up?

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Koyo has the cure for Aroma's troubles—but first, he must examine her rear end?

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Koyo knows the secret to increasing a girl's cup size, but first he must avoid the vice principal's trap!

Girovagando senza meta si imbatte nella compagnia intenta nell'ultima prova e scopre che l'unica donna della compagnia, Laura ha appena lasciato il gruppo: per questo Nami si offre, dietro pagamento, di prendere il suo posto.

info.title: Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
info.synopsis: Akane Tsuda, un'office lady ventottenne, sembra avere sempre tutto sotto controllo. Bella ed intelligente, è un'impiegata indispensabile per un'azienda nell'ambito della robotica che viene ammirata da tutti i suoi colleghi... solamente perché non possono vederla in casa. Nel privato Akane è un disastro, con un appartamento che sembra quasi una discarica per quanto è trascurato! Per fortuna che, da ubriaca, ha ordinato un nuovo androide di nome Nadeshiko per aiutarla nelle faccende domestiche. Ma forse non è un bene, visto che la nuova bellissima androide in arrivo è estremamente vogliosa. Akane sta per ricevere più servizi del previsto!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Akane Tsuda (28), who works in the product planning department of a major electronics manufacturer, is doing well at work and is well-liked by those around her, but her private life is a disaster! Her room is a mess and she has a bad drinking habit, so in a drunken rage, she buys a robot to do household chores. Later, she receives a delivery of an "adult" android named Nadeshiko…

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Akane sighs as she heads home earlier than usual. And no wonder—since the other day, an illegal adult robot named “Nadeshiko” has been staying at her house! Since Nadeshiko, who just arrived, doesn't have any underwear, the two head out to buy some together. Once they do, Nadeshiko goes to change in the bathroom, but she doesn't come back for a while...?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Akane jolts awake from a nightmare in which her workplace discovers she bought an illegal romance robot named Nadeshiko. The very source of her worries, Nadeshiko, appears to be sleeping soundly beside her. Huh? ...Come to think of it, robots don't sleep, do they? Is she powered down? Akane manages to charge Nadeshiko safely, but then realizes she doesn't know how to restart her...?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Seeing Akane exhausted from her grueling work, Nadeshiko offers her a regular massage. Following that, Nadeshiko asks Akane to perform a “Master Authentication,” but Akane refuses the request. Master Authentication would mean becoming Nadeshiko's owner, but Akane explains she can't treat Nadeshiko like an object because she feels too human for that. Akane says she'd rather start as friends first, to which Nadeshiko responds...?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Akane on her way home. Though troubled by how deeply she's becoming bound to Nadeshiko, she feels grateful—unlike before—that her own home is lit up, that someone is waiting for her there. And who greets Akane upon her return, in this state...? Nadeshiko, wearing nothing but an apron...?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Akane has been invited to an anonymous online meetup exclusively for Romanceroid owners. Though uneasy about the anonymous sender, she decides to attend, hoping to uncover Nadeshiko's secret. Waiting before Akane, filled with anxiety, are owners dressed in fairy-tale-like animal costumes—a dog, a rabbit, and a bear...?

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Akane (and Nadeshiko, who came along out of concern) stayed at a leisure hotel during a business trip. While enjoying the large bath, big bed, and stylish meals unique to leisure hotels, Akane braced herself for “that sort of thing” with Nadeshiko... but nothing happened at all!? Left completely untouched, Akane drifted off to sleep in frustration, when suddenly, a voice began coming from the TV...?

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: One day after consecutive overtime shifts, Nadeshiko worries when Akane comes home late as usual. Before Akane can even reply, she collapses at the entrance. Though she wakes up, Akane has regressed to infancy (?) due to exhaustion. Nadeshiko tries every trick in the book to nurse her back to health. Mistaking Nadeshiko for her own mother, Akane starts acting clingy toward her...?

info.title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Avventura su Hand Island (ITA)
info.synopsis: Viaggiando per il Nuovo Mondo, la ciurma di Cappello di paglia viene attaccata dalla Marina e per sfuggire a una palla di cannone gigante finisce su Hand Island, un'isola abitata da mastri artigiani. Mentre i suoi compagni cercano un modo per raddrizzare la nave e lasciare l'isola, Rufy fa la conoscenza di Diego, un artigiano della cera che ammira i pirati e il loro stile di vita libero.

info.title: My Classmate's a Sexy Actress, and Now We Live Together?!
info.synopsis: La storia ruota attorno a Ryōsuke Kamiya, uno studente universitario che un giorno, mentre guarda un video pornografico online, rimane scioccato nel riconoscere tra gli attori la sua compagna di università, Rūka Someya. Turbato dalla scoperta, Ryōsuke decide di parlarle in privato per chiederle spiegazioni. Quando la affronta, Rūka ammette la verità, ma per evitare che la notizia si diffonda gli propone un accordo: sarà disposta ad avere un rapporto con lui purché mantenga il segreto e non riveli a nessuno ciò che ha scoperto.

episodes.title: Keep Quiet and I'll Give It To You
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke Kamiya, a third-year college student, is paired up for a presentation with Ruka Someya, a classmate from his seminar whom he secretly finds cute. His joy is short-lived, however, as Ruka—claiming she's too busy with her part-time job—proves to be no help at all, leaving him to prepare for the presentation almost entirely on his own… While working at home, Ryosuke loses his concentration and starts browsing an adult video streaming site, only to be stunned by the sight of a sexy actress who looks exactly like Ruka…?!

episodes.title: Let Me Stay Here
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke tries to apologize again for what happened last night, but Ruka blackmails him with footage she'd secretly taken of him completely naked in his sleep. Her demand was that she be allowed to live in Ryosuke's spacious apartment. An unlikely living arrangement begins between a dull college guy and a sexy gyaru film star! The two start off with the shopping to get ready for their new life together. On the way back, Ruka brings up something that takes Ryosuke a bit by surprise…

episodes.title: This Really... Turns Me On
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke's innocent question about situation-based adult films leads them to explore an old, disused university club building. Ryosuke and Ruka wander through the abandoned clubroom. It's a thrilling situation where they're all alone in a place where no one is likely to come, yet they might just get caught by someone! Ruka looks exasperated at Ryosuke, who can't help but get excited at the thought…

episodes.title: I'm Doing My Best, Okay?!
episodes.synopsis: Ruka has gone out for a shoot. Ryosuke understands the logic that filming is just part of the job for an active adult film actress… yet the unease in his heart won't fade. He knows he shouldn't watch, but he can't take his eyes off Ruka in the video, and his unease only grows. When night falls and Ruka returns home after finishing her shoot, Ryosuke—who's been lost in thought all day—is exhausted and gaunt. This has Ruka worried, but unusually for Ryosuke, he initiates sex with her…

episodes.title: I Love Someya-san
episodes.synopsis: Having realized his feelings for Ruka, Ryosuke musters his courage and asks her out on a date to the aquarium. Though he still couldn't bring himself to confess his feelings, Ryosuke was able to enjoy the day off with Ruka. On the way home, they stop at a family restaurant, and the conversation eventually turns to Ruka's family. Ryosuke then discovers that her family was connected to the reason she became a sexy actress…

episodes.title: I Have Something To Show You!
episodes.synopsis: Winter arrives. Students in recruitment suits become a common sight on campus. Seeing them, Ryosuke, now conscious of the job hunt, asks Ruka if she plans to continue working as a sexy actress, to which she answers… Ruka shows Ryosuke herself in a recruitment suit. Ryosuke puts on his own suit to show her, but unlike Ruka, it doesn't suit him at all. Just as Ryosuke is feeling down, Someya suddenly appears before him as... Section Chief?!

episodes.title: Are You Sure About It?
episodes.synopsis: It's Christmas Eve. Ryosuke invites Ruka to a fancy dinner at a hotel he'd splurged on. He makes a small blunder there, but it ends up making him respect Ruka even more. The two go straight to their room, and as they gaze at the beautiful night view, Ryosuke finally confesses his feelings to Ruka! But Ruka feels the urge to tell him something important, all the more so because he is someone so dear to her… What will become of the confession?!

episodes.title: Let's Stay Together Forever!
episodes.synopsis: Ryosuke and Ruka are now officially a couple. Ruka had, in fact, also prepared something special for today… And as the seasons turn, spring arrives with cherry blossoms in full bloom. With his final year approaching, Ryosuke is overwhelmed with anxiety about the events ahead, such as his thesis and job hunting. In contrast, Ruka doesn't seem too fazed for some reason… Here's the finale of the story about falling in love with Ms. Someya, a former adult film actress from the same seminar class!

info.title: KAMUI: He's Behind You
info.synopsis: Shizuka Mizuzuka è una studentessa delle superiori che possiede un dono insolito: può vedere i fantasmi. Questa capacità la espone continuamente a presenze inquietanti e fenomeni soprannaturali che rendono la sua quotidianità tutt'altro che normale. La svolta arriva con l'incontro con Kamui, un esorcista potente ma decisamente eccentrico. Coinvolta nelle sue attività, Shizuka diventa la sua assistente e si ritrova ad affrontare spiriti maligni e casi sempre più strani.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The ringing of the phone echoes through a high-rise building late at night. The voice on the other end introduces herself as Mary-san. Shizuka is pursued by her via every phone call, no matter the room she flees to or the hallway she runs down. What encounter awaits Mary-san after cornering Shizuka?! Teketeke a wandering spirit that seeks after its lower half of the body, lost in an accident. Shizuka, who was forced to listen to the story from Kamui, finds the ghost before her 'as promised,' unaware that this was a clever trap set up by Kamui.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Hiding her psychic ability, Shizuka hopes to enjoy school life as an ordinary student. However, her peace is shattered through her friend, Inagawa, who brings in a Kokkuri-san sheet. A spirit appears in response to Inagawa and the others' summons, and its evil grasp closes in on Shizuka. Can Kamui fulfill Shizuka's request to perform an exorcism 'secretly, without anyone seeing'?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: A cursed checkered doll that keeps returning no matter how many times it's disposed of is brought into Kamui's office. The doll challenges Kamui to take her on in the purification ritual. But there, she witnesses Kamui's unimaginable lifeforce and exorcism methods firsthand. While searching for a girl who's been spirited away, Shizuka is captured by the Gap Woman. Will Kamui be able to rescue Shizuka who's trapped in a narrow gap of a building where she is out of reach?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Shizuka is forced into a elementary school costume—tight-fitting clothes and a school backpack. As she grieves over the random punishment, the Slit-Mouthed Woman presses her, asking if she looks pretty. Shizuka flees to the empty school after classes. What is Kamui's secret plan, waiting for her in the infirmary? Kamui receives a message from Shizuka that she's going to hang out with her best friend Kyoko, and upon seeing the attached photo, he senses something. Will Shizuka be able to hide Kamui's exorcism from Kyoko?!

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Oichi, the cursed Ichimatsu doll who was defeated in her battle against the Slit-Mouthed Woman, gets picked up by a young girl named Yui and becomes her cherished playmate. Then, a black cat that Yui had found joins them as a new playmate. But that cat was no ordinary black cat! With Yui's life and the top spot of playmate on the line, the battle between Oichi and the black cat begins!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Shizuka, who has gone for a drive with Kamui, picks up a soaking-wet woman along the mountain pass at night. Eerie handprints appear on the fogged-up windows, and the sound of the car creaking begins to echo from outside. A night of terror begins! Showing off her youth in a tight bikini as she sits in the driver's seat, Shizuka is pursued by the Jet Hag Gang—the mountain pass's supernatural menace! Oichi's driving skills and Kamui's techniques explode onto the nighttime mountain pass!

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The ghostly phenomenon of the girl Hanako-san is haunting elementary schools all over Japan. Kamui and Shizuka join forces to exorcise them all at once. As their friends are exorcised one after another, the Hanako-san from all over Japan panic, and they gather at an abandoned school deep in the mountains. What is the desperate plan they have devised to turn the tide?!

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: A voluptuous mother and her cute daughter visit the office from abroad. When the mother asks Kamui to exorcise the succubus possessing her, Kamui suddenly rips her clothes off! He kicks a flustered Shizuka out of the room and begins the exorcism. Will Shizuka merely stand by and watch Kamui's battle, which could potentially become an international incident?

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: After being ambushed by a succubus and having his life force completely drained, Kamui naturally (?) falls into Hell. However, declaring that he has business to get down to, Kamui aims to return to the living world and confronts Enma the Great, who enforces the rules of the underworld. Meanwhile, in the living world, the creature Fire Cart attempts to possess Kamui's lifeless body. Will Shizuka and Oichi be able to protect Kamui's body from getting taken over?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious beauty named Lily Kiskil transfers to Shizuka's school. Shizuka feels as if she's met Lily somewhere before, but Lily presses forward relentlessly. Then, a supernatural phenomenon attacks them without mercy. Shizuka, who longs for an ordinary school life but finds that the abnormal is becoming the norm, and Kamui, who has gone into training to gain greater power, cross paths in the mountains!

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: After sucking out Kamui's life force, Lily somehow loses the ability to attack humans. While feeling worried as her power wanes day by day, she spends her days enjoying the lively company of Shizuka and the others. One such day, Lily decides to keep a vigil to protect Shizuka, who has been possessed by a nightmare. Meanwhile, Kamui, the one she needs most, is away from the office on other business. The curtain rises on a night spent alone between Lily, starving for spiritual energy, and Shizuka, the perfect prey for the supernaturals.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: After spending the night with her friend Lily, Shizuka wakes up to find that Lily had vanished from the office. Filled with unease, Shizuka heads to school, only to discover that Lily had been erased from the memories of both teachers and students. In search of proof that Lily had ever existed, Shizuka rushes out of school. Meanwhile, Kamui gazes at the morning sun, recalling last night's battle. What was the outcome of the fight with Lily, in which they staked their very existence, their pride, and the things they could never compromise on?!

info.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
info.synopsis: Rain è un mago con un'abilità unica: può assegnare "punti di potenziamento" a qualsiasi oggetto, migliorando armi, armature e strumenti fino a renderli estremamente potenti. Per anni ha sostenuto la sua gilda rafforzando l'equipaggiamento dei compagni, ma una volta raggiunto il limite dei potenziamenti viene allontanato senza riconoscenza, considerato inutile. Ferito dal tradimento, Rain annulla tutti i potenziamenti concessi in passato e recupera un'enorme quantità di potere. Usandolo su se stesso e sui propri oggetti, scopre di poter creare equipaggiamento di livello incredibilmente alto, persino superiore a quello leggendario. Così decide di lasciarsi tutto alle spalle e iniziare una nuova vita da avventuriero, vivendo in libertà e sfruttando la sua abilità "cheat" in un mondo fantasy ricco di incontri e sfide.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Rein is unceremoniously kicked out of the Beast's Fangs, so he decides to become an adventurer.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: With help from legendary adventurer Lily Flambert, Rein defeats a mid-level dragon.
